title: Escalation latency SLA intake and decision matrix for key accounts
creator: Priya Raman
description:
Problem: Top accounts repeatedly escalate feature or reliability asks through support/AE channels. Without a consistent intake and time-to-decision SLA, we (1) surface critical asks late, (2) over-allocate engineering cycles to ambiguous requests, and (3) inconsistently promise commitments to customers. This creates churn risk for high-ACV accounts and operational overhead for PM/SE teams.

Goal: Create an SLA-driven intake and decision matrix that routes, prioritizes, and commits (or defers) top-account escalations within defined time windows. The system should be deterministic, auditable, and surfaced in the Console so stakeholders and customers have a clear expectation of the timeline and outcome.

Scope:
- Intake form + enrichment pipeline: an AE/Support/Customer-facing form with automated enrichment (ACV, renewal date, contract SLOs, active incidents, prior escalations).
- Weighted decision matrix: configurable weights for signals (ACV, time-to-renewal, incident severity, regulatory impact, strategic priority).
- SLA tiers: define three latency buckets (24h Rapid Response, 72h Committed Review, 10d Roadmap Consideration) with clear outcomes per bucket (acknowledge, scoping meeting, commitment/no-commit).
- Routing & actions: automatic routing to PM/SE/EM on-call based on score and SLA tier, Slack notification, and a Console entry with timeline/state.
- Dashboards & audit logs: metrics for time-to-decision, % of escalations meeting SLA, and downstream commit accuracy vs. delivered items.

Non-goals: full automation of commit decisions (decision support only), replacing existing enterprise playbooks (we will integrate with them), backfilling historical escalations beyond 6 months in MVP.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form collects required signals and enrichment populates ACV, renewal, and incident status
Weighted score is calculated in < 2s for any request and stored in Console
Escalation is routed and Slack + email notifications are triggered per SLA tier
Dashboard shows time-to-decision and SLA compliance with filters for account and product area
Runbook published to Confluence and internal on-call trained for the flow
Pilot with 5 strategic customers completes with < 80% false positives (validated by AE/CS feedback)
tasks: Define signal weights and default SLA thresholds (PM lead + Sales ops)
Design intake form UX and Console escalation card (Designer: product-design)
Implement backend enrichment service and score calculator (ENG)
Add routing hooks -> Slack channels + Pager/EM on-call mapping
Pilot rollout to 5 customers and collect feedback (Solutions + Customer Success)
Iterate weights and publish final playbook
risks: Overweighting ACV could bias against important technical reliability asks for lower-value accounts
Dependency on accurate enrichment data (CRM sync issues will break scores)
Slack/notification noise if thresholds are too permissive
Customer perception risk if we route to 'Consideration' without clear comms
mitigations: Introduce a manual override flag for PM/CS to escalate true reliability incidents
Fallback to manual triage if enrichment returns stale data; clearly surface provenance
Start with conservative thresholds and a 2-week monitoring mode before full rollout
Draft templated customer communications for each SLA outcome and train AEs
